newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ZUELLE MISSES START OF TOUR STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZUELLE MISSES START OF TOUR STAGE.

text.p: Swiss Alex Zuelle, involved in three falls on successive stages this week, missed the start of the fifth stage of the Tour de France on Thursday.
The Once team leader was not injured in the crashes but dropped to 73rd overall, four minutes 17 seconds adrift of leader Mario Cipollini of Italy after only four stages.
Zuelle, involved in accidents on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, broke his collarbone in last month's Tour of Switzerland and only just recovered in time for the French race.
The Swiss, among the pre-Tour favourites, was second in 1995 and won the Tour of Spain last year.
